## Description
Detect invalid configurations where current sources are connected in series, which violates Kirchhoff's current law.

## Problem
Current sources in series must all have the same current value, otherwise the circuit is invalid. This is a common mistake that leads to simulation errors.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Detect series-connected current sources
- [ ] Check if current values match (for valid series connection)
- [ ] Provide clear error messages
- [ ] Identify the specific sources and nodes involved
- [ ] Integrate with validation system

## Technical Approach
- Identify current sources in the circuit
- Check for series connections (single path between sources)
- Validate current values match if in series

## Priority
Medium - Less common than voltage shorts but still important
